Metadata.title: Nodvis Finance
Metadata.description: Clear and secure household finance management.

HomePage.title: Overview
HomePage.description: See your available funds, cash flow, and the most important household changes.
HomePage.publicHeroTitle: Your household finances in clear order
HomePage.publicHeroSubtitle: Effortlessly manage accounts, spending, and savings in one clear place.
HomePage.noData: No data for the selected period.

next.title: Next stage
next.description: Household, accounts, cash, balances, categories, manual transactions and transfers — without double-counting money movements or collapsing available cash into debt.

Auth.signInDescription: Enter your email and password to access your finances.
Auth.noHouseholdDescription: This user account is not linked to any household in the system yet.
Auth.signUpDescription: Create an account to start managing your household finances.
Auth.errorSignUp: Failed to create account. Please check your details.

Onboarding.title: Create your household
Onboarding.description: Set up your household to begin managing funds, accounts, and obligations.
Onboarding.errorGeneric: Failed to create household. Please check your input and try again.

HouseholdSelection.title: Select household
HouseholdSelection.description: You belong to multiple households. Choose which one you want to view.

Accounts.title: Accounts & balances
Accounts.description: Manage bank accounts, savings, cash wallets, and credit cards with exact balance snapshots.
Accounts.emptyActiveDescription: Add your first bank account, cash wallet, or credit card below.
Accounts.emptyArchivedDescription: No archived accounts in this household.
Accounts.addIdentifierHelp: Enter the full 26-digit Polish account number or international IBAN. Safe masking is applied in all ordinary views.
Accounts.archiveConfirm: Archive this account? History and transactions will remain intact.

form.name: Account name
form.namePlaceholder: e.g. Main Checking, Home Cash, Visa Card
form.ownersHelp: Select who in the household owns this account.
form.initialBalanceHelp: Leave empty if the balance is unknown. Decimals are parsed with exact minor units.
form.creditCardNotice: For credit cards, enter negative value for outstanding debt (e.g. -250.00).
form.errorGeneric: An error occurred while saving the account.
form.errorOwnersRequired: Please select at least one owner.

Categories.title: Categories
Categories.description: Organize expenses and income with household-scoped categories.
Categories.emptyArchivedDescription: No archived categories in this household.
Categories.archiveConfirm: Archive this category? Historical transactions will retain this category.

form.name: Category name
form.applicabilityHelp: Specify whether this category applies to expenses, income, or both.
form.errorGeneric: An error occurred while saving the category.
form.errorDuplicateName: A category with this name already exists in this household.

Liabilities.title: Liabilities
Liabilities.description: Track loans, mortgages, installments, and credit lines with exact balances and repayment history.
Liabilities.emptyActiveDescription: Add your first loan, mortgage, or installment plan below.
Liabilities.emptyArchivedDescription: No archived liabilities in this household.
Liabilities.archiveConfirm: Archive this liability? Historical repayments will be preserved.

form.name: Liability name
form.namePlaceholder: e.g. Home Mortgage, Auto Loan, Laptop Installments
form.lenderPlaceholder: e.g. PKO BP, Santander, Allegro Pay
form.destinationAccountHelp: Select a household account (e.g. credit card) if repayments should transfer directly to it.
form.observedOutstandingHelp: Leave empty if current balance is unknown. Parsed with exact minor units.
form.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Fixed rate until 2028, monthly payment ~1200 PLN
form.errorGeneric: An error occurred while saving the liability.
form.errorSnapshotDateRequired: Observation date is required when entering an outstanding balance.

repaymentForm.title: Record repayment
repaymentForm.allocationHelp: Principal, interest, and fees can be left blank if unknown. When all three are provided, they must sum exactly to the total repayment.
repaymentForm.sourceAccountHelp: If selected, automatically records a cash movement (transfer or expense) with full audit trail.
repaymentForm.errorGeneric: An error occurred while recording the repayment.
repaymentForm.errorAmountRequired: Repayment amount is required and must be greater than zero.
repaymentForm.errorAllocationExceeded: Sum of principal, interest, and fee cannot exceed total repayment amount.
repaymentForm.errorAllocationMismatch: When principal, interest, and fees are all supplied, their sum must exactly equal total amount.

voidForm.title: Void repayment
voidForm.description: Voiding will mark this repayment as void and also void any linked cash transaction with an audit log.
voidForm.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Bank correction, erroneous duplicate entry
voidForm.errorGeneric: An error occurred while voiding the repayment.

Transactions.sectionDescription: Record expenses, income, and transfers between owned accounts while preserving financial rules.

form.categoryHelp: Optional. Assign an active category to this transaction.
form.amountHelp: Enter amount in decimal format (e.g. 123.45 or 100). Both dot and comma are accepted.
form.errorGeneric: An error occurred while saving the transaction.
form.transferInvariantNotice: Per financial rules, an internal transfer is neither income nor spending and does not change total household funds (INV-001).
form.transferRequiresTwoAccounts: At least two accounts are required in the household to record a transfer.
form.transferSameAccountError: Source and destination accounts must be different.
form.transferCurrencyMismatchError: Transfers are only supported between accounts with the same currency.
form.transferNoMatchingCurrency: No other account shares the same currency as the selected source account.
form.noAccounts: No accounts in the household yet. Please add an account to record transactions.
form.amountRequired: Enter a valid positive amount greater than zero (e.g. 123.45).

details.title: Transaction details
details.auditTrailNotice: This transaction record is permanently preserved for audit integrity.

history.title: Change history
history.description: Trustworthy immutable audit trail of all recorded modifications to this transaction.
history.loadError: Failed to load change history. Please try again.
history.baselineNotice: Initial baseline prior to change tracking

edit.description: Correct this transaction. Balance snapshots and audit history remain safe.
edit.errorConflict: This transaction was modified elsewhere. Please refresh to see the latest version.
edit.errorGeneric: An error occurred while saving corrections.

void.title: Void transaction
void.description: Voiding removes this transaction from active balance effects without deleting it. The audit record, timestamp, and optional reason will be preserved permanently.
void.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Duplicate entry, wrong amount entered, returned purchase
void.errorConflict: This transaction was modified or already voided. Please refresh.
void.errorGeneric: An error occurred while voiding the transaction.

list.title: Recent transactions
list.description: Recorded financial operations in the household.
list.emptyVoidedDescription: No transactions have been voided in this household.
list.emptyDescription: No transactions have been recorded in this household yet. Use the form above to add an expense, income, or transfer.

filters.title: Filter transactions
filters.noResultsDescription: No transactions matched the selected filters. Try changing or clearing your criteria.

Footer.tagline: Nodvis Finance — simple and secure personal finance.
Footer.privacyNote: All your financial data remains confidential and fully protected.

Imports.title: Import a CSV statement
Imports.description: Add a statement, review recognized operations, and resolve only the items that need your attention.
Imports.automaticSummary: Safe automatic processing: {safe}; needs attention: {attention}. Uncertain rows will not be saved.
Imports.noAccountsDescription: You must create at least one household account before importing a CSV statement.
Imports.dropzoneHint: Drag and drop your CSV statement file here, or click to browse.
Imports.deleteProfileConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this profile?
Imports.autoProcessSafeCheckbox: Automatically import safe rows upon preview
Imports.autoProcessSafeHint: Only unambiguous rows verified safe by identity logic will be imported. Ambiguous, duplicate, voided-match, or possible manual match rows remain for manual review.
Imports.autoCommittedSuccess: Automatically imported {count} safe transactions. {attention} rows require attention / manual review.

errors.generic: The import could not be completed.

Transfers.title: Internal transfers
Transfers.description: Review and match money transfers between your household accounts without double-counting expenses or income.

hints.readyAuto: Both sides of this transfer have arrived with matching amounts, matching currency, and a confirmed account identifier linking your accounts.
hints.reviewOnly: Amounts and dates match between accounts, but no registered account number confirmed this link. Manual confirmation is required.
hints.oneSidedPending: An outflow was sent to a known household account number, but the counterpart deposit has not arrived or been imported yet.
hints.ambiguous: Multiple candidate counterparts were found for this transfer, or currencies differ. Choose the correct counterpart manually.

empty.readyAutoDescription: All confirmed transfer counterpart pairs have already been matched.
empty.reviewOnlyDescription: No unconfirmed transfers with matching amounts and dates were found.
empty.oneSidedPendingDescription: No outflows to known accounts are waiting for their counterpart deposit.
empty.ambiguousDescription: There are no candidate transfers with multiple counterpart options.
empty.reconciledDescription: Matched internal transfers will appear here in the history.

feedback.noAutoMatched: No transfers were eligible for automatic matching.
feedback.errorGeneric: Failed to match transfer. Please try again.

availableCash.allFresh: Observed from all {count} active asset accounts
availableCash.partialWarning: Partial data: {count} account(s) have unrecorded or stale balance

categorySpending.description: Breakdown of expenses recorded in this period.
